name: Retatrutide
description: Experimental injected peptide (LY3437943) that acts on three hormone receptors: GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon

note.text: A heart and kidney outcomes trial of about 10,000 people is due to finish in 2029.

bullets: **Acts on three hormone receptors** at once: GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon
**Given once a week** under the skin in trials
**No FDA label,** so there is no approved mechanism statement
**Heart rate** rose with dose in Phase 2, peaked at 24 weeks, then fell

practical.routes: Injection under the skin, once weekly (trials)
practical.soldAs: Not approved; FDA says it cannot be compounded
practical.monitored: Weight, HbA1c, heart rate, knee pain, sleep apnea index
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status unconfirmed

regulatory.text: Not approved; cannot be used in compounding
Not authorised; MHRA says sales are illegal
Not named; class S0 may apply

references: Jastreboff et al., TRIUMPH-1, N Engl J Med, Sep 2026
Jastreboff et al., retatrutide Phase 2 in obesity, N Engl J Med, Aug 2023
FDA, Concerns with unapproved GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss, Oct 2026
